meta.name: Stingray Classica
meta.description:
Discover breathtaking classical music concerts, operas, and ballets from some of the grandest venues around the world.

Shows: Ludwig Wicki, Danish National Symphony Orchestra, DR Junior Choir & Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger, Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra, Martha Argerich, Iddo Bar-Shai, Maxim Vengerov & Mischa Maisky, Zhu Xiao-Mei, Evgeny Kissin, Nikolai Demidenko, Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra & Antoni Wit
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
